translation.name: Geeshsha Mas'aafaa
translation.englishName: The Holy Bible in the Dawuro language of Ethiopia, Latin script

content: Yesuusanne Nik'oodimoosa
Parisaawatuwaappe gideedda kaappuwaa Nik'oodimoosa geetettiyaa itti bitanii de'ee.

Nik'oodimoosi k'amma Yesuusakko yiide, «Tamaarissiyaawoo, neeni nuuna tamaarissana mala S'oossay kiitteedda gidiyaawaa nuuni ereetto; ayaw gooppe, S'oossay aanana de'iyaa asaappe attin, ha neeni ootsiyaa wolk'k'aama malaatatuwaa ootsanaw danddayiyaa Asay baawa» yaageedda.
Yesuusi zaariide, «Taani new tumuwaa oday; Asay laa'entsuwaa yelettana d'ayooppe, S'oossaa kawutetsaa be'anaw danddayenna» yaageedda.
Nik'oodimoosi, «C'ima Asay waaniide laa'entsuwaa yelettanaw danddayii? Bare daay uluwaa simmi geliide, laa'entsuwaa yelettanaw Asay danddayii?» yaageedda.
Yesuusi zaariide, «Taani new tumuwaa oday; Asay haatsaappenne Geeshsha Ayyaanaappe yelettana d'ayooppe, S'oossaa kawutetsaa gelanaw danddayenna.
Asay ashuwaan asaappe yelettee; shin Asay ayyaanaan Geeshsha Ayyaanaappe yelettee;
‹Hinttenttu laa'entsuwaa yelettanaw bessee› gaade taani odeedda diraw, maalalettoppa.
C'arkkuu bare koyyeeddasaa c'arkkee. Neeni Aa kooshunchchaa sisaasa; shin I hak'appe yintto woy hak'a bintto erakka. Geeshsha Ayyaanaappe yeletteedda ubbay hewaa mala» yaageedda.
Nik'oodimoosi, «Hawe waaniide hananaw danddayii?» yaagiide oochcheedda.
Yesuusi zaariide, «Neeni Israa'eelatuwaa tamaarissiyaawaa gidaadde hawaa erikkii?
Taani new tumuwaa oday; nuuni eriyaawaa haasayeettonne be'eeddawaa markkatteetto; shin nuuni markkattiyaawaa hinttenttu akkikkita.
Taani hinttenttoo sa'aabaa odina, ammanennawantta gidooppe, saluwaabaa odina waan ammananitee?
Saluwaappe wod'd'eedda taappe attin, saluwaa keseeddawe ooninne baawa; saluwaan de'iyaa Asaa Na'ay taana.
«Muse woraan s'ank'k'imaaluwaa shooshshaa sulleeddawaadan, taana ammaneedda ubbay med'inaa de'uwaa akkana mala, taani Asaa Na'ay mask'k'aliyaa bolla pude denddana bessee.
«S'oossaa Na'aa ammaniyaa ubbay med'inaa de'uwaa akkanaappe attin, d'ayenna mala, S'oossay ha alamiyaa asaa loytsi siik'eedda diraw, bare mes's'i itti Na'aa immeedda.
Ayaw gooppe, S'oossay bare Na'aa ha alamiyaa asaa pirddanaw kiittibeenna; shin unttuntta Aa baggana ashshanaw kiitteedda.
«Aa Na'aa ammaniyaa ooninne pirddettenna; shin Na'aan ammanenna ooninne, S'oossaa Na'aa ittuwaa ammanibeenna diraw, ha"ikka pirddetti utteedda.
Asaa bolla yiyaa pirdday hawaa: Poo'uu ha alamiyaa yeedda; shin asaa kiitay iita gidiyaa diraw, poo'uwaappe aatsiide, d'umaa siik'eedda.
Iitabaa ootsiyaa ooninne poo'uwaa is's'ee; ayaw gooppe, bare kiitay k'onc'c'enna mala, poo'uwaakko shiik'enna.
Shin tumuwaa ootsiyaa ooninne S'oossay azazeeddawaadan, I ootseeddawaa poo'uu k'onc'c'issana mala, poo'uwaakko shiik'ee» yaageedda.
Yesuusanne S'ammak'iyaa Yohaannisa
Hewaappe guyyiyaan, Yesuusinne Aa kaalliyaawanttu Yihudaa gadiyaa beeddino; Yesuusi he gadiyaan unttunttunna amareeda wodiyaa uttiide, asaa s'ammak'iidde de'ee.
K'ay Yohaannisi Saaleeme mataan de'iyaa Henoona giyaa saan wogga haatsay de'iyaa diraw, Asay aakko yiina s'ammak'ee.
Hewe haneeddawe Yohaannisi k'ashettanaappe kasenna.
Hewaappe guyyiyaan, Yohaannisa kaalliyaawanttunna amareeda Ayihudatuwaa meechchaa wogaabaa
palumetteeddino.
Unttunttu Yohaannisakko biide, «Tamaarissiyaawoo, Yorddaanoosa Shaafaappe hefintsan neenanna de'iyaawe, neeni aabaa markkattowe, be'a ha"i s'ammak'ee; Asay ubbaykka aakko bee» yaageeddino.
Yohaannisi zaariide, «S'oossay immana d'ayooppe, Asay ayinne akkanaw danddayenna.
‹Taani Kiristtoosa gidikke; shin taani aappe sintsaw kiitettaad› geeddawoo hintte hinttenttu huup'ew markka.
Mishira mac'c'awunna de'iyaa uray ikka mishiraa; he mishiraa miyaatay ek'k'iide, I giyaawaa sisiyaawe Aa haasayaan daro nashettee. Hewaa diraw, hawe ta nashechchay poletteedda.
I darina ta guus's'ana bessee» yaageedda.
Bollappe yiyaawe ubbaappe bollaa. Sa'aappe beetteeddawe sa'aassa. Ikka sa'aabaa haasayee. Saluwaappe yiyaawe ubbaappe bollaa.
I bare be'eeddabaanne siseeddabaa markkattee; shin Aa markkatetsaa akkiyaawe baawa.
Aa markkatetsaa akkiyaa ooninne S'oossay tumanchcha gidiyaawaa hewan markkattee.
S'oossay kiitteeddawe S'oossaa k'aalaa odee; ayaw gooppe, S'oossay bare Geeshsha Ayaanaa palahissiide immee.
S'oossay bare Na'aa siik'iide ubbabaa Aa kushiyan wotseedda.
Na'aa ammaniyaa uraw med'inaa de'uu de'ee; shin Na'aa ammanennaawaa bolla S'oossaa hank'k'uu de'anawaappe attin, I de'uwaa be'enna.

footnotes.text: Ayihudatuwaa meechchaa wogaabaa: Hawaa guussay Ayihudatuu barenttu goynaanna gatsanaw ootsiyaa dumma dumma barentta meechchaabaynne barenttu saaniyaa meec'c'iyaa wogatuu de'iyaawaa bessee.
